pipeline.name: Face Analysis (DeepFace)
pipeline.description: Face detection (RetinaFace) and expression recognition using DeepFace, with optional age and gender estimation, producing COCO format output.
pipeline.title: Faces: where they are and their expression
pipeline.summary: Finds faces in each sampled frame and estimates each face's expression. Can also estimate age and gender, which are off by default.

parameters.name: detection_backend
parameters.label: Face detector
parameters.description: Face detection backend (opencv, deepface, ssd, dlib, mtcnn, retinaface)

parameters.name: confidence_threshold
parameters.label: Detection confidence
parameters.description: Minimum confidence threshold for face detection

parameters.name: max_faces
parameters.label: Most faces per frame
parameters.description: Maximum number of faces to detect per frame

parameters.name: scale_factor
parameters.label: Haar cascade scale factor
parameters.description: Scale factor for OpenCV Haar cascades

parameters.name: min_neighbors
parameters.label: Haar cascade neighbours
parameters.description: Minimum neighbors for OpenCV Haar cascades

parameters.name: detect_age
parameters.label: Age
parameters.description: Enable age estimation (downloads a 540 MB model on first use)
parameters.reason: Off by default: the model was trained on adult faces and says nothing useful about infants.

parameters.name: detect_gender
parameters.label: Gender
parameters.description: Enable gender prediction (downloads a 540 MB model on first use)
parameters.reason: Off by default: the model was trained on adult faces and says nothing useful about infants.

parameters.name: deepface
parameters.label: DeepFace models
parameters.reason: RetinaFace detector: 91.4% AP on WIDER FACE's hard set, and the best detector in DeepFace's portfolio by its own account; the earlier OpenCV Haar cascade found no faces in the demo clip.
